name: hub
alt: The Policy Exchange page: the site's status with Waiting to publish, and on the right the Publish and Highlight doors and Edit live items.

pins.label: Waiting to publish: what Publish would add now
Publish: the page that sends the waiting items to the site
Highlight: the big card on the site's home page
Edit live items: the site's own door to fix, hide or delete a live item

name: publish
alt: Publish: Checked against the live Exchange, a note that a rewrite is not checked yet, the coloured bar with 2 adding, 1 held for newsletter and Already live, the table with each row's Fate, and Publish 2 to the Exchange at the top right.

pins.label: Check them on Finalize: read each rewrite before it goes out
A colour: click it to show only those rows
Fate: Adding, Held for newsletter, Needs a fix or Already live
Publish N to the Exchange: asks for the password next

name: publish-ask
alt: The ask that replaces the Publish button: Publish 2 to the live Exchange?, a Password field, Confirm and Cancel.

pins.label: Password: the desk password, the one Content Sort asks for
Confirm: adds the rows to the live site
Cancel: nothing is sent

name: highlight
alt: The Highlight page: On the site now lists what the big card shows, with a card made on the Exchange last; Your picks has each pick with Replace photo or Add photo, its Until day, arrows and Remove, and No card words yet with Write the card.

pins.label: On the site now: what the big card shows this minute
Add photo or Replace photo: a picture file from your computer
Until: the last day the pick stays on the card
Write the card: the card's own words for an event or opportunity

name: highlight-pick
alt: Pick from: a Search box, the section filters All, Research, Events, Opportunities and Headlines with counts, and the table of live items, each with Highlight, or In and its place once picked.

pins.label: Search: by title or source, every live item
A section: show only its items
Highlight: adds it to Your picks
In, 2nd: already picked, and its place on the card

name: highlight-save
alt: Under Your picks once a pick changed: Update the highlight and Cancel changes.

pins.label: Update the highlight: asks for the password, then Confirm
Cancel changes: back to what the site shows now
